mapper.select: SELECT LOT_ID, EQP_ID, EQP_RECIPE_ID, OPER_ID, TIMEKEY, FAC_ID, SECTION_NM, FLOW_ID, AVG_VAL_1, START_TM, PREDICT_END_TM, RN, '' AS NEXT_OPER FROM ( SELECT H.LOT_ID, H.EQP_ID, H.EQP_RECIPE_ID, H.OPER_ID, H.TIMEKEY, H.FAC_ID, H.SECTION_NM, H.FLOW_ID, R.AVG_VAL_1, TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP( SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(H.TIMEKEY), 1, 14) || '.' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(H.TIMEKEY), 15, 6), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS.FF6' ),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF6') AS START_TM, CASE WHEN R.AVG_VAL_1 IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP( SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(H.TIMEKEY), 1, 14) || '.' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(H.TIMEKEY), 15, 6), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS.FF6' ) + NUMTODSINTERVAL(R.AVG_VAL_1, 'MINUTE'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF6') ELSE NULL END AS PREDICT_END_TM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY H.LOT_ID, H.TIMEKEY ORDER BY -- 1 순위: H.OPER_ID 와 R.OPER_ID 이 같은거 CASE WHEN H.OPER_ID = R.OPER_ID THEN 0 ELSE 10 END, -- 2 순위: R.OPER_ID 가 ALL CASE WHEN R.OPER_ID = 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 10 END, -- 3 순위: 기타등등 CASE WHEN R.OPER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 10 END ) AS RN FROM MES_LOT_HIS H LEFT JOIN RTS_LOTCDSCHTIME_INF R ON H.EQP_ID = R.EQP_ID AND H.EQP_RECIPE_ID = R.RECIPE_ID AND R.TYP_VAL = 'PROC_PITCH_TIME' -- AND (H.OPER_ID = R.OPER_ID OR R.OPER_ID = 'ALL') WHERE H.EVENT_CD = 'JobStart' AND H.DET_FAC_ID IN ('M16A','M16B','M16E') AND H.TIMEKEY >= '%s' AND H.TIMEKEY < '%s' ) WHERE RN = 1

SELECT t.FLOW_ID, t.OPER_SEQ, t.OPER_ID, t.MID_OPER_TYP, t.IS_STOP_POINT FROM ( SELECT A.FLOW_ID, A.OPER_SEQ, B.OPER_ID, B.MID_OPER_TYP, CASE WHEN B.MID_OPER_TYP = 'Processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_STOP_POINT FROM MES_NODE_MAS A JOIN MES_OPER_MAS B ON A.NODE_ATTR_VAL_1 = B.OPER_ID WHERE A.FAC_ID = '%s' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MES_LOT_HIS H WHERE H.EVENT_CD = 'JobStart' AND H.DET_FAC_ID IN ('M16A','M16B','M16E') AND H.TIMEKEY >= '%s' AND H.TIMEKEY < '%s' AND H.FLOW_ID = A.FLOW_ID ) AND A.NODE_TYP = 'ProcessOperation' ) t Order By t.FLOW_ID, t.OPER_SEQ

SELECT A.FLOW_ID, A.OPER_SEQ, A.NODE_ATTR_VAL_1 AS OPER_ID FROM MES_NODE_MAS A WHERE A.NODE_TYP = 'ProcessOperation' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MES_LOT_HIS H WHERE H.EVENT_CD = 'JobStart' AND H.DET_FAC_ID IN ('M16A','M16B','M16E') AND H.TIMEKEY >= '%s' AND H.TIMEKEY < '%s' AND H.FLOW_ID = A.FLOW_ID )

SELECT A.ACT_FLOW_ID, A.ACT_OPER_ID, A.LOT_ID, A.ACT_NM FROM BIZ_LOTFUTUREACT_INF A WHERE 1 = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MES_LOT_HIS H WHERE H.EVENT_CD = 'JobStart' AND H.DET_FAC_ID IN ('M16A','M16B','M16E') AND H.TIMEKEY >= '%s' AND H.TIMEKEY < '%s' AND H.LOT_ID = A.LOT_ID AND H.FLOW_ID = A.ACT_FLOW_ID AND H.OPER_ID = A.ACT_OPER_ID ) AND ACT_NM IN ('Monitor') AND ACT_YN = 'N'

SELECT T.OPER_ID, T.MID_OPER_TYP, T.OPER_VER FROM MES_OPER_MAS T WHERE T.FAC_ID = '%s' AND T.OPER_VER = '00001' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MES_NODE_MAS A WHERE A.NODE_TYP = 'ProcessOperation' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MES_LOT_HIS H WHERE H.EVENT_CD = 'JobStart' AND H.DET_FAC_ID IN ('M16A','M16B','M16E') AND H.TIMEKEY >= '%s' AND H.TIMEKEY < '%s' AND H.FLOW_ID = A.FLOW_ID ) AND T.OPER_ID = A.NODE_ATTR_VAL_1 )

SELECT M.LOT_ID FROM MES_LOT_MAS M WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MES_LOT_HIS H WHERE H.EVENT_CD = 'JobStart' AND H.DET_FAC_ID IN ('M16A','M16B','M16E') AND H.TIMEKEY >= '%s' AND H.TIMEKEY < '%s' AND H.LOT_ID = M.LOT_ID ) AND M.OWNER_CD NOT LIKE '%s' AND M.DET_FAC_ID IN ('M16A','M16B','M16E')

SELECT LOT_ID, RETURN_OPER_ID FROM ( SELECT M.LOT_ID, M.RETURN_OPER_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY M.LOT_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_TIMEKEY DESC) AS NUM FROM SFAB_LOTMOVE_MAS M WHERE 1=1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MES_LOT_HIS H WHERE H.EVENT_CD = 'JobStart' AND H.DET_FAC_ID IN ('M16A','M16B','M16E') AND H.TIMEKEY >= '%s' AND H.TIMEKEY < '%s' AND H.LOT_ID = M.LOT_ID ) AND M.MOVE_STAT_CD != 'Complete' -- ORDER BY M.LOT_ID, M.SEND_TIMEKEY DESC ) WHERE NUM=1
